heroPattern: poster: the event name stacked over its date and place at the full width of the content column, with the supporting line and the main action under them and no image beside them; a lead image, when one is supplied, runs below as a wide strip; on narrow screens the same stack with the name one display role smaller
navigation: none; a sticky main action appears on narrow screens after the hero
footer: minimal: logo, organiser line and legal links
